title: Debt affordability study.
bodyText: The director of finance shall submit to the legislature a debt affordability study prior to the convening of the regular session of each odd-numbered year. The director shall submit the study with the multi-year program and financial plan.
bodyHtml: [§37C-12]  Debt affordability study.  The director of finance shall submit to the legislature a debt affordability study prior to the convening of the regular session of each odd-numbered year.  The director shall submit the study with the multi-year program and financial plan. [L 2015, c 149, pt of §2]
